description: A SourceMapConsumer is created for every loaded file and never destroyed.

provenance.construction: reverse of 77be80c859: the new side of the diff is the code before the change

expected.rationale: The consumer holds WebAssembly memory that has to be released with destroy(). The deleted SourceMapConsumer.with call released it automatically. Without it, every processed file leaks memory, which slows large builds, as the linked issue reports. MEDIUM is a judgement, not an advisory rating.

issues.description: new SourceMapConsumer(...) is created and awaited but never destroyed, so each file leaks the memory the consumer holds.
